summary: Alzamend Neuro filed an 8-K reporting the death of director Lynne Fahey McGrath on July 20, 2026. The filing is a standard current report disclosing the passing of a board member, with no transaction, strategic review, or special situation involved. The company expresses condolences but does not announce any changes to operations, governance, or capital structure. No deal terms, activist activity, or restructuring is present. This is a routine disclosure filing, not a special-situation event.
